issues.message: @Async method returns a future that is still pending (CompletableFuture.runAsync(...)): Spring's interceptor calls get() on it on the executor thread, so the thread is held until it completes — the default executor saturates like a blocking call (measured: https://github.com/Joaquinriosheredia/java-vibe-guard/blob/11651ca/cli/verify/async-pending-future/results/criteria.md#L15-L23)
